List the priors of a bison_brm() regression

Source: R/bison_brm.R
bison_brm_get_prior.Rd

Shows the parameters of a bison_brm() regression that can be given priors, and their default priors, using brms::get_prior(). Use it before fitting to choose priors, which can then be set with the prior argument of bison_brm(). A prior is the distribution that describes what is plausible for a parameter before seeing the data.

Usage

bison_brm_get_prior(
  formula,
  edgemodel_list,
  data_list,
  scale = c("none", "centre", "z"),
  subset = NULL,
  z_score = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

A brms formula containing one bison() term, as for bison_brm().

edgemodel_list

A fitted bison_model object, or a list of them.

data_list

A data frame of regression variables, or a list of them, as for bison_brm().

scale, subset, z_score

As for bison_brm(). The scale of the network variable affects the default priors, so use the same values as in bison_brm().

...

Additional arguments passed to brms::get_prior(), such as family.

Value

A data frame of priors (a brmsprior object) from brms::get_prior(), with one row per parameter or class of parameters.

See also

bison_brm(), brms::set_prior()

Examples

sim_data <- simulate_bison_model("binary", aggregated = TRUE)
df <- sim_data$df_sim
fit_edge <- bison_model(
  (event | effort) ~ dyad(node_1_id, node_2_id),
  data = df,
  model_type = "binary_conjugate",
  priors = get_default_priors("binary_conjugate")
)
bison_brm_get_prior(
  bison(edge_weight(node_1_id, node_2_id)) ~ age_diff + (1 | mm(node_1_id, node_2_id)),
  fit_edge,
  df
)
#>                    prior     class      coef                group resp dpar
#>  student_t(3, -0.5, 2.5) Intercept                                         
#>                   (flat)         b                                         
#>                   (flat)         b  age_diff                               
#>     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                         
#>     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd           mmnode_1_idnode_2_id          
#>     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd Intercept mmnode_1_idnode_2_id          
#>     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)     sigma                                         
#>  nlpar lb ub tag       source
#>                       default
#>                       default
#>                  (vectorized)
#>         0             default
#>         0        (vectorized)
#>         0        (vectorized)
#>         0             default
